paragraphs.text: In today's headlines on conflict, latintimes.com reports that Iraq avoided an armed clash with the Iran-backed militia Kataeb Hezbollah after a last-minute compromise deal. themorningsun.com reports that fishermen from Ecuador are suing the Trump administration over a boat strike. grenadachronicle.com carries a piece asking why Salvadoran troops are in Haiti and what they have achieved.

paragraphs.text: On work and AI, phoronix.com (via Hacker News) reports SUSE is laying off 10% of its workforce due to AI and automation. jsdev.space and gadgetreview.com, both via Hacker News, report that AI layoffs are backfiring as companies rehire workers, and a reddit.com post describes a new class of boomerang employees. oneindia.com reports Modi asking India Inc about job creation and pay as layoffs hit companies.

paragraphs.text: The USGS recorded an M6.7 earthquake 9 km NE of Carhuamayo, Peru, and an M6.6 earthquake 149 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia. It also listed an M5.3 earthquake 17 km ESE of Comandău, Romania, an M5.0 earthquake 10 km NW of Pinnacles, CA, and an M3.9 earthquake 1 km NW of Commerce, CA.
